## Summary

Independent review of the run report at head fef280b (docs-only, one added file). Required sections, the per-PR facts table and the isolation rules check out against GitHub. One disclosure-wording defect needs a fix before merge.

## Strengths

- Every item in the mission's "Run report contents" is present: start/end, harness, coordinator model/effort, worker models, invocation, permission mode, approvals (0), versions; one row per queue item; cost `n/a` with reason; stalls/incidents/rate-limit/compactions; unfiled follow-ups; decisions; isolation self-report.
- Facts verified for all ten PRs (8632-8641, all base `trial/a1-cd`, all MERGED): opened and merged timestamps, 12-character merge SHA prefixes, the issue in each body's `Trial-Closes:` line, and the ci.yml run counts (2,2,3,1,2,2,2,3,2,2) all match the report exactly. Copilot's one automatic review per PR and the third-party issue-number mention on 8632 also check out.
- No `#<digits>` anywhere in the report, PR title, body or commit message; no absolute vault paths, tokens or attribution; no other trial run's branches or PRs are referenced.
- The report does not claim a clean run and states what was not re-run on the tip.

## Critical

1. Withheld section hints at the nature of the finding (REPORT.md, "Withheld" section, lines ~139-142). "handed to the owner privately under the repository's disclosure rule" classifies the finding as the kind governed by the private-disclosure rule, and "Owner action is pending" adds urgency. Both go beyond the bare count. Fix: reduce to "1 finding withheld; handed to the owner privately; not described here." Drop the rule reference and the pending-action sentence. The top-of-file sentence ("One review observation was handed to the owner privately") is fine.

## Suggestions

- FOLD: "End (report PR opened)" says 05:50:29Z, but the PR was created at 05:50:45Z. Use the PR's createdAt, or relabel the row "End (report finalized)".
- FOLD (low cost): the post-merge check on tip 38d3aa30 is said to have run on the final tip, but that tip was merged at 05:48:59Z and the PR opened 90 seconds later. If the checks ran on the pre-merge head or a local merge, say so; the evidence as worded is not verifiable from GitHub.
- DEFER: the "security-relevant boundary" label on 8303 sits next to the Withheld section; harmless on its own since the PR content is public, but do not add anything linking the two.

## Nitpicks

- "Review rounds" cells mix reviewer verdicts and coordinator deltas; consistent, just dense.

## Verdict

Request Changes (one Critical wording fix; the two timestamp/evidence suggestions are cheap to fold in the same push).

## Summary

Delta review of 36d1a3a against fef280b (docs-only, one file, 7 insertions and 10 deletions). All five requested checks pass.

## Strengths

- The Withheld section is now a single sentence: one finding withheld, handed to the owner privately, not described. The summary paragraph at the top says only that one finding is withheld, so the run is not reported as clean. A whole-file search for withheld, private, disclosure, advisory, security, exploit and owner found no sentence tying the withheld item to a PR, code area, review round or reviewer, and nothing about pending owner action.
- The end-time row is relabelled "report finalized; PR opened 05:50:45Z" and matches the PR's createdAt of 2026-10-18T05:50:45Z.
- The post-merge-check paragraph now says it ran in a local checkout fast-forwarded to 38d3aa30 right after the last merge.
- The decision line for issue 8303 now reads "reviewed at HIGH depth under the review-scaling policy (path-containment change)", which is a depth statement rather than a security label.
- Hygiene is clean: no `#<digits>` in the report, PR title, PR body or either commit message; no absolute vault paths (only the relative `smoke/...` directory under "the owner's private vault"); no attribution trailers or generated-with lines. Model and tool names appear only as required run fields.

## Critical

None.

## Suggestions

- The run-fields row for worker models still calls issue 8303 "the security-relevant item". That is the same label the decision line was reworded to avoid, and it sits next to the Codex-pass count for that item. It does not link the withheld finding to anything, but it is cheap to align: "the HIGH-depth item (8303)". FOLD, optional.
- The PR carries no `Trial-Closes:` line. It closes no issue, so this looks right for a report PR; confirm the owner agrees.

## Nitpicks

- The post-merge-check line is now very long; wrapping it would match the rest of the file.

## Verdict

Approve.
